blocks.html: The design wind pressure, p, used in the design of the main wind-force-resisting system shall not be less than 16 psf (0.766 kN/m 2 ) multiplied by the area of the building or structure projected on a vertical plane normal to the wind direction. In the calculation of design wind pressure, p, used in the design of components and cladding for buildings, the algebraic sum of the pressures acting on opposite faces shall be taken into account. The design pressure for components and cladding of buildings shall not be less than 32 psf (1.533 kN/m 2 ) acting in either direction normal to the surface. The design force for open buildings and other structures shall not be less than 16 psf (0.766 kN/m 2 ) multiplied by the area A f .
